_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Strong at the settlement gate. ⚑ QUESTS: the MILITIA leg of D9's branch — `wolves-on-the-road` carry_word → told_militia, rewarding Taunt + 400 XP; the Shaman carries the other leg to a different stage with a different reward, and no code knows there is a choice. ⚑ Q4 SHAPE (conversation-journal §4.6, R1): the turn-in is a row directly at root — the quest is not his, so there is no quest node; the Q1 show-rule keeps the row invisible except at carry_word. The teaching is a named row; the front is a lore answer-node.
name: CityGuard

lines: Sorry, can't let you in — the orcs are too close.

options.text: Word from the west road: eight wolves are dealt with.

grants.line: Eight. Written down, and the commander will have it before nightfall. We don't thank people — we pay them.
Here. A beast that's looking at you isn't looking at the man behind you. Learn to make it look.
Stand up straight. You've done more for that road than the last three patrols.

options.text: Teach me to stand like a soldier.

grants.line: Strength is drilled, not wished for. Let me show you.

options.text: Where can I make myself useful?

lines: The front in the south wants every hand that can hold a line. Prove yourself there.
